title: SessionRequest v1 (LG-01)
description: What Unity or the command line asks for when a trainee wants a fresh practice scenario. Assessment mode is refused: assessment keeps fixed cases.

seed.description: optional; drawn and logged when absent

focus.description: behaviour or dimension ids the trainee or teacher wants exercised

time_budget_s.description: how long the trainee will wait for generation before the pre-generated pool is used
